params.prompt: Precise small edit to this same photograph, creating the immediately preceding ready-to-extract pose. REMOVE the face-up card completely, restoring matching green felt. Keep both hands EMPTY. Move the RIGHT receiving hand (viewer left hand whose fingers point at the removed card) a small distance to the right so its fingers are immediately beside the low front mouth of the existing shoe, ready to receive a card. The LEFT feeding hand (viewer right) remains touching the shoe mouth. Both hands adjacent near that same outlet, wrists and elbows low, no crossed fingers, no touching each other, no card outside shoe. Preserve exact Astrid face, hair, gaze, full-length black jacket sleeves to wrists, ivory blouse, body silhouette, scene framing, all lights, table typography and shoe. Change no other pixels or pose.

content.text: This tool provides an auto-updating generation widget for these jobs. Do not call job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids to display these jobs again, either before or after completion, unless the user explicitly requests a separate display. If you need to await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15. Use job_display only if the user explicitly requests a separate re-display of one specific job.

Note: adjustments applied — medias[0].role: "image" → "image_references" (GPT Image 2.5 backend expects schema-key media roles).
